description: This Java class implements a platform service for reading share account charges, providing methods to retrieve charges based on account ID and status, mapping database rows to ShareAccountChargeData objects, and constructing SQL queries dynamically.

classes.name: ShareAccountChargeReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: A service implementation class that retrieves share account charges from the database, mapping the data to domain objects.

classes.name: ShareAccountChargeMapper
classes.description: A private static inner class that implements RowMapper to convert SQL result sets into ShareAccountChargeData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAccountCharges
methods.description: Fetches a collection of ShareAccountChargeData for a given account ID and status, building the SQL query dynamically based on status.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a row from the SQL ResultSet to a ShareAccountChargeData object, extracting and converting database values appropriately.
